Selected outside sources

Editorial starting points, not a ranking.

  • Omaha hi-lo: hand construction and low qualification

    PokerStars · Free · Official rules

    Explains exactly two hole cards, the eight-or-better low qualifier, and splitting or scooping the pot.

    Before you use it: Operator rules page, not a strategy chart. High and low can use different card combinations; confirm the exact variant and betting structure.

    Public page read · 2026-10-08 · Full listing

  • Eight-game mix: games and rotation

    PokerStars · Free · Official rules

    Lists the eight component games and explains changes in the game and betting structure.

    Before you use it: The published rotation timing belongs to this operator. Live events can use a different number of hands or a different order.

    Public page read · 2026-10-08 · Full listing

  • Badugi rules and showdown comparisons

    Pagat · Free · Reference

    Look up the deal, drawing rounds, hand comparison, and the treatment of incomplete four-card hands.

    Before you use it: Rules reference rather than strategy instruction. Confirm local variations before using it to interpret a particular event.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing
